searchText: Does `execution-spec-tests` have any TSTORE tests? Doesn't look like it. reference test cover a lot of ground - https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/EIPTests/StateTests/stEIP1153-transientStorage and https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/EIPTests/BlockchainTests/bcEIP1153-transientStorage I have these covered. I was looking for moar... https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/230 Blockchain tests for tstore are one of the examples where blockchain tests add value that statetest cannot. They test that tstore is cleared between transactions of the same account.
